scope: Session-only GR engine-level power-gating disable request, one RTX 5080 configuration. Software requests and masks, not physical residency.

contract.transport_origin: Unmodified NVAPI initialization/unload capture, corroborated with Windows handlers; not Linux ioctl numbers.

static_findings.scope: Static offline analysis of one Windows 617.42 driver; offsets are evidence identities, not compatibility constants.

dispatch.attr_0x37: controller support bit from group+0xe8, record+0xf1 true, record+0x110 zero, and virtual predicate

manager.selector: feature 6 case 0x42b784 selects nonempty group0 else group1 and group3 independently; group mask at group+0x1930+4*group index
manager.concurrency: manager 0x6a4690 calls callback only at aggregate count zero; overlapping profiler clients need not cause transitions
manager.initializer: 0x42c1f0 creates feature 6 object stored manager+0xc08; constructor 0x6a4610 assigns callback 0x42b350
manager.hold: 0x7522a0 iterates mask ->0x73a3b0 sets reason bit0 at record+0x110 and increments reason-zero count at +0x10c

static_findings.conclusion: No direct exposure of group+0x1930 masks found in type3 dispatch. Attr 0x39 is support bitmap membership, not proven membership of the selected groups. Attribute 0x48 supports a partial reason-bit witness, but cannot alone prove complete controller coverage or distinguish another request with same reason.

negative_trials.result: First production run rejected unstable successive readback after Hold. Explicit Release/free succeeded; later serialized complete controller state matched baseline. Initial False comparison mixed integer in-memory mask keys with JSON string keys; correction preserved in artifact.
No mutations. Controller4 enabled_predicate changed true/false/true with identical support and reason masks. Live predicate stability must not gate stable request-mask verification.

production_qualification.stable_fields: All inventory/support/reason-mask fields; enabled predicate remains latest diagnostic observation. No board/driver/observed-controller allowlist.

limits: Changed controller masks are a partial witness, not complete GR group membership or an ownership getter.
Overlapping requests can hide a new transition; successful no-transition requests remain unverified and explicitly releasable.
No measured physical gating, power savings, clock or timing effect.
No registry write, driver restart, Windows reboot, workload or profile persistence.
No automatic reapply; driver-restart cleanup not exercised.
Other profiler clock-gating and idle-slowdown controls remain unqualified.
